_comment: Template for ~/.config/pi/agent/settings.json, which is NOT tracked: pi
rewrites it on every install and model switch, and it carries whichever
provider and model this machine happens to use. common/setup.sh reads
`packages` and runs `pi install` for any entry missing from settings.json
(idempotent). `theme` is the default off Omarchy; on Omarchy setup.sh
sets `omarchy-system` instead, which the theme-set hook keeps in sync
with the active Omarchy theme and pi hot-reloads.
Providers and credentials belong in models.json, which is also untracked.
